tool_args.rationale: All five paid rows are short-horizon observations, so the fast positive response can fit multiple mechanisms while leaving the slow adaptation amplitude and timescale uncertain. With a target H of 21.6, acquire the specifically discriminating slow-horizon probe before fitting and confirming a model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model from the existing five rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The rows only cover H=0.16–0.48, while the target horizon is 21.6; the short-H data do not identify the slow adaptation term needed for the forecast.
Higher-resolution short-window data would not resolve the slow-horizon ambiguity as directly.
It is irrelevant to distinguishing the candidate mechanisms and should not be purchased.
It remains a competing mechanism, but the existing sink-gradient signature and the high-H probe are more informative for resolving it.
